# Atlas (2024 film)
In 2043, an AI terrorist named Harlan leads a war against humanity, fleeing into outer space. Twenty-eight years later, in 2071, Atlas Shepherd, a woman with deep distrust of AI and the daughter of Harlan's creator, searches for him. After discovering Harlan has escaped to a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy, she joins a mission to capture him using AI-assisted mecha known as ARCs. During the mission, she bonds with the ARC's AI, Smith, overcoming her distrust. Despite being captured and nearly killed by Harlan, Atlas and Smith survive and fight their way to defeat Harlan. In the end, Smith survives and retains a memory of Atlas, suggesting a form of consciousness persists beyond the original program. The film explores themes of AI autonomy, human-machine relationships, and personal redemption.
